title: Recessed Toilet Paper Holder 6.125-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection, In-Wall Mount | Autumn Sparkle | Allied Brass
description:
Add a recessed toilet paper holder to your bathroom for a streamlined, built-in appearance that saves space in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round. This in-wall toilet tissue holder is part of the Carolina Collection and is designed to coordinate with transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Autumn Sparkle transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware supports a clean look
- Designer finish for corrosion-free and rust-free performance
- All mounting hardware included

Specs:
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Recessed
- Dimensions: 6.125 in (L) x 4 in (W) x 6.125 in (H)
- Projection: 4 in
- Weight: 2.4 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
